results.name: even_ranks_only
results.description: Cards with even ranks are accepted.

results.name: red_cards_only
results.description: Only red cards (hearts and diamonds) are accepted.

results.name: hearts_and_clubs
results.description: Only hearts and clubs are accepted.

results.name: alternating_colors
results.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors.

results.name: rank_higher_than_previous
results.description: Each card's rank must be higher than the previous one.

results.name: same_suit_as_previous
results.description: Each card must have the same suit as the previous one.

results.name: red_to_low_rank_black_to_high_rank
results.description: Red cards must have a rank ≤ 7, and black cards must have a rank ≥ 7.

results.name: alternating_ranks_odd_even
results.description: Cards must alternate between odd and even ranks.

results.name: increasing_then_decreasing_ranks
results.description: Ranks must first increase and then decrease (e.g., 3, 5, 7, 5, 3).

results.name: specific_suit_sequence
results.description: Cards must follow a sequence of suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, repeat).
